item.title: Sprint b-6 — sc-cron: Python hook target, enabled flag, stop-hook action

results.statement: sc-cron, the SQLite cron job scheduler crate, must remain a general-purpose job scheduler that the sc-runtime repository can copy.
results.quote: I expect 'sc-cron' to be a general tool that can be used for scheduling jobs. [...] should retain that general purpose shape for porting (copying) to sc-runtime.
results.context: phase-b planning session, 2026-10-25 (Rand); wording by bc-lead under Rand's instruction to use judgement
results.deterministic_check: cargo tree -p sc-cron shows no bd-cache-* or sc-beads dependency; grep finds no beads or cache types in crates/sc-cron/src
results.explanation: The directive is carried forward.

results.statement: sc-cron's cron table must have an enabled boolean column that enables or disables a schedule without rewriting the row.
results.quote: cron table should have an 'enable' bool flag so scheduled tasks can be enabled/disabled w/out needing to rewrite the entire row.
results.context: phase-b planning session, 2026-10-25 (Rand); wording by bc-lead under Rand's instruction to use judgement
results.deterministic_check: a test toggles enabled and asserts the row's generation, expression and payload are unchanged
results.explanation: The directive is carried forward.

results.statement: sc-cron, the SQLite cron job scheduler crate, must let a schedule define a stop hook that returns the string value continue, disable or delete.
results.quote: sc-cron should include the ability to define a `stop hook` [...] allow stop hook to return a stringenum with values 'disable', 'delete', 'continue' (or similar)
results.context: phase-b planning session, 2026-10-25 (Rand); wording by bc-lead under Rand's instruction to use judgement
results.deterministic_check: tests cover each of continue, disable and delete for a Rust and a Python stop hook
results.explanation: The directive is carried forward.

results.statement: Words on the prohibited list of the repository's no-consumer lint (`scripts/lint_no_atm.py`) must not appear in this repository outside that lint, its tests and `docs/team-protocol.md`; the lint passes on the whole tree.
results.quote: blocking [a prohibited word: the consumer's cron principal] and the other words on the lint's prohibited list from source or tests (Rand, 2026-10-25, paraphrased; the verbatim text is in git history)
results.context: phase-b planning session, 2026-10-25 (Rand); wording by bc-lead under Rand's instruction to use judgement
results.deterministic_check: `python3 scripts/lint_no_atm.py` exits 0 on the whole tree; per sprint, `python3 scripts/lint_no_atm.py --paths <sprint fence>` exits 0
results.explanation: Structural anchor: verified by its deterministic_check, not by Jev

results.statement: Every code deliverable in a phase-B sprint plan must cite a REQ or ADR identifier that justifies it.

results.explanation: Structural anchor: verified by its deterministic_check, not by Jev

results.statement: When bd cannot be reached, beads-cache must keep answering reads from the cache and record an outage for the affected scopes.

results.deterministic_check: the outage tests show reads still answered and the scope's outage recorded on spawn failure, timeout and transport errors

results.explanation: Excluded from this bead by the anchor's exclude list: sc-cron stays generic; the consumer-registered Python sync that replaces the built-in bd sync is planned in b-7.

results.statement: beads-cache must support an optional consumer-registered post-sync hook that receives the bd sync results and errors.
results.quote: there can also be hooks necessary to report/escelate based on [the first consumer's] requirements [...] We would also likely want a 'post-sync' hook that could contain sync results and errors and allow consumer [the first consumer] to do custom things at that point (Rand, 2026-10-25, paraphrased; the verbatim text is in git history)
results.context: phase-b planning session, 2026-10-25 (Rand); wording by bc-lead under Rand's instruction to use judgement
results.deterministic_check: an end-to-end test asserts the post-sync hook request carries each scope's result and error

'phase' is a concept of [the first consumer and its messaging tool, whose names are prohibited words].  other applications would have different scopes including --all. (Rand, 2026-10-25, paraphrased; the verbatim text is in git history)
